profile.headline: Software Engineer & Architect
profile.summary:
Steven Williams has over 25 years of experience developing enterprise web applications with a focus on scalable data-driven solutions and modern software architecture. He started developing data-driven software in 1999 and implemented his own Content Management System at the University of Texas at Austin in early 2000.

Currently serving as Software Architect at Advisor360, Steve leads the design and implementation of multi-tenant SaaS architectures for enterprise CRM solutions. He has architected comprehensive texting and communication systems, Firebase messaging infrastructure, and RESTful API services that serve diverse client configurations across multiple environments.

Steve has extensive experience developing custom features for large multi-tenant applications and enterprise platforms. He has extensive experience with code review processes, and release management systems for complex projects. Throughout his career, Steve has successfully migrated data from numerous sources while maintaining data integrity and has leveraged technologies like Solr to implement advanced search capabilities with extended data storage solutions.

Steve is frequently called upon to write architecture documents, with a particular talent for simplifying and optimizing complex applications. He has increased the adoption of AI-assisted development practices, improving team velocity and code quality. Steve has also contributed code to many open source projects and is passionate about leveraging emerging technologies to accelerate development while maintaining enterprise-grade quality and scalability.

His expertise spans full-stack development with Angular, TypeScript, Javascript, PHP, Firebase, multi-tenant architecture design, API development, and cross-functional team leadership in agile environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer and Architect
positions.description:
Software Architect specializing in scalable multi-tenant SaaS architectures, RESTful API design, and enterprise CRM solutions

Currently leading architectural initiatives for multi-client platforms, designing systems that serve diverse business requirements while maintaining security, performance, and operational efficiency.

Key Expertise:
• Multi-tenant architecture design and implementation
• RESTful API design, development, and integration
• Enterprise CRM system integration (Tandem, configuration management)
• Real-time messaging and push notification systems (Firebase Cloud Messaging)
• AI-assisted development workflows and code optimization
• Full-stack development with Angular, Firebase, Rest API and cloud technologies
• Cross-functional team leadership and technical specification authoring

Passionate about leveraging emerging technologies like AI and modern cloud platforms to accelerate development while maintaining enterprise-grade API design and scalability.

positions.title: President & CEO
positions.description:
I have worked in software development for more than 18 years. I founded Zilleem as a software  company focused on helping clients managing data and solve problems. We work with clients to develop Websites, Apps, and Digital Formats. We develop on content management systems like Drupal, Joomla and WordPress to name a few. We use Git for managing code and Agile processes to deliver for clients. We prefer Docker and Linux environments, but have not meet an environment we can not work with. 

If you need a software solution,  support, or want to chat let me know.

positions.title: Vice President of Engineering
positions.description:
- Lead developers and work with clients to collaborate, discover and implement new features.
- Lead architecture design, and code integration.
- Assist with sales and client Services.
- Perform Project Management role on projects.
- Perform code and analysis reviews.
- Integrate and extend external APIs.
- Integrate and develop Solr queries and work with clients to tune results.
- Develop Drupal Commerce solutions.
- Write custom modules to extend Drupal.
- Implement data migration between platforms.

positions.description:
- Implement data migrations between platforms and storage systems. 
- Enhance performance of data queries. 
- Extend Drupal as a data platform with API integration.
- Develop custom modules to extend Drupal features.
- Expand Drupal’s storage system with denormalization, NoSQL and document storage solutions.

- Work with clients to collaborate and develop new features.
- Member of 2012 SXSW Austin Drupal Bash Expert Panel.

company.name: University of Texas at Austin Libraries

positions.title: Webmaster / Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained online systems including website, digital repository, online catalog, and online journal services.
- Launched and managed new instance of DSpace repository for storing digital objects, graduate theses and professor publications.
- Implemented and managed Drupal Content Management System and transitioned custom applications, into Drupal.
- Developed new sites using Drupal and Solr. 
- Monitored online resources to insure they meet web and accessibility standards.
- Participated on committees and helped lead evaluations of new technology platforms.
- Worked with clients and content owners for training and development of new features.
- 2009 Fall Web Author Gathering - Presented: Introduction to the Libraries JavaScript framework (jQuery).
- 2009 Fall: Instructed: Texas Digital Library's day course on Customizing DSpace.
- 2009 Spring: Instructed: Texas Digital Library's day course on Customizing DSpace.
- 2008 Texas Conference on Digital Libraries – Presentation on Sometimes its the Simple Things.

positions.title: Web Developer / Photo Coordinator
positions.description:
- Created online record management system and transitioned card catalogs, including newspaper morgues, visual materials and vertical files into new system.
- Developed a Digital Media Repository for tracking stored digital assets and managed workflow of data created from new projects into the repository.	
- Managed website redesign and transition of content from flat HTML files to a CMS.				
- Developed custom Content Management System for managing website and assets association between Content Management and Digital Media Repository.
